newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains slip as NYMEX unleaded eases.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains slip as NYMEX unleaded eases.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices drifted off early highs made on a combination of a hefty draw in U.S. gasoline stocks and trade hedging, but traders said underlying sentiment remained bullish and prices ended overall firmer.

Today's EIA report said gasoline stocks fell by 2.3 million barrels last week. U.S. stocks are estimated around 10.3 million barrels lower than this time last year, with implied demand running at nearly eight million barrels per day.
Physical barge prices jumped around $4-5 a tonne with Eurograde barges trading up to $207.75 fob ARA early on trader house buying, but slipped back to $205/$206 later.
Regular traded $200.50. Cargoes too were slightly firmer but discussion remained muted.

Swaps climbed $3 a tonne with March drifting back into a small backwardation over April in early business. The March April spread talked around 50 cents to $1 in backwardation in late business with April swaps valued around unchanged at $203.50.

Traders said the early gains were solely as a result of a squeeze play on spring gasoline between two trade houses. Both are thought to be running large swaps positions and have been actively buying physical barges.
